name: zetetic-insights
description: The learning loop: every main turn is kept in a ledger across sessions (phase, effort, steps, failed tool calls, agents, advisor calls), joined with the session outcomes /insights writes and the project's goals; a phase whose evidence says so gets its tool-loop effort moved one notch, written to a calibration file the autopilot reads. /calibrate apply, /calibrate reset. Starts in observe: proposals are shown, not applied.

learning_mode.title: Learning mode
learning_mode.description: observe (default): proposals are shown in the cockpit's INSIGHTS panel and applied by /calibrate apply. enforce: a proposal is written to the calibration file as soon as the evidence supports it.
